title: Shoo, Dragon, Shoo!
cheer: Zap! The dragon jumps back from {spot}!
opening: A grumpy dragon fell asleep on the Fairy Throne, and its smoky snores are darkening the forest! Dragons can't stand fairy sparkles. Chase it away, one sparkle at a time!
not_yet: Shh! Wrong spot. The dragon is still snoring. Follow the clue!

steps.clue: Dragons hate getting wet, it's true! The Waterfall has a splash for you. Fill your wand with sparkly spray!
The dragon sneezed and rolled around. Now find the tree with roots in the ground. The Old Oak hides a tickly breeze!
The dragon hid its smoke away, in the Dark Cave where shadows stay. Shine your light and chase it out!
Its wings are flapping, it's almost gone! The Mushroom Ring will help you on. Wave where the little caps grow round!
One last sparkle, big and bright! Run to the Throne with all your might, wave your wand and shout SHOO!

ending: WHOOSH! The dragon flew off over the rainbow to find a new nap spot far, far away. The forest is bright again, and you are the Dragon Chaser of the Fairy Forest!
